aggregation: max of the 5 m-baseline Horn slope (DEM block-averaged from 1 m to 5 m; a block with any NoData pixel is NoData) over the slope values sampled in the cell; NoData if any contributor is unknown or has no slope value
layout: row-major from the north-west corner of each tile
subsamples_per_cell: 5x5 points per app cell, each mapped to its nearest native 1 m pixel
source: MRO HiRISE DEM 1 m, set 1159 (esp_058996_1985_esp_058930_1985_tied-dem.tif), Day et al. 2023
